road_activity.basis: Annual totals sum exactly 12 source-estimated calendar months. Miles per resident use the same-year US population; absent denominators remain null. Partial years are never annualized.
road_activity.limitations: Historical FHWA/FRED numeric archive through August 2023, not seasonally adjusted. Mirror retrieval is not source-release vintage. Estimates may have been revised since this archive. Combined passenger/freight road travel; no link, vehicle, commodity or OD detail. Miles per resident are aggregate road use, not an individual's travel.

airport_inventory.limitations: Current non-closed OurAirports facilities with source country US. Includes heliports, seaplane bases and small airfields, not just scheduled passenger airports. Facility types are infrastructure classes, not vehicle classes or traffic. Unrecognized or blank state codes remain unassigned; no location is imputed. US-territory facilities coded as other countries by the source are outside this US-country filter. Download time is not a verified publisher release vintage.

data_quality.basis: Observed annual records between each series' first and last available source year. Current inventories, estimates and forecasts are excluded.

quality_semantics: validated means schema, finite nonnegative numeric values, year and key checks passed. Source accuracy has not been independently verified. source_estimate marks upstream estimates, not internal forecasts. provisional marks experimental model output.
